hints.title: Greedy Interval Scheduling
hints.text: Sort all tasks primarily by their ending time in ascending order.

hints.title: Overlap Maximization
hints.text: For each task, count how many time points in [start, end] have already been chosen.

hints.title: Rightmost Slot Preference
hints.text: If additional time points are needed, greedily pick the rightmost available integer points close to the ending time to maximize future task reuse.

hints.title: Rightmost Greedy Scheduling Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting m tasks takes O(m log m); filling slots takes at most m * T steps where T <= 2000.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive time point search across subsets of points is NP-hard without greedy interval structure.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sorts by end time and fills rightmost slots to maximize future task reuse.
